decisions.reason: As a flagship product with repeated gold-medal recognition and a strong fit with the firm's confectionery strengths, its value is largely revealed and the low incremental cost of continuing it makes withdrawal very unlikely.

This bread remains on its own page after the firm already pruned other 2023 bread launches, so it appears to have passed an initial market test and is worth keeping open because continuation is relatively low cost despite some assortment-overlap risk.

The marzipan stollen is close to the firm's established seasonal offer and complements the award-winning premium stollen, so the option is still attractive to retain given modest uncertainty and limited additional resource commitment.
